subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Amazon: The Everything Store
description: One-minute skill: Amazon: The Everything Store.

hook.text: Jeff Bezos started Amazon in his garage in 1994, selling only books.

buildup.text: One-click ordering and customer reviews made online shopping feel safe and convenient.

discovery.text: Amazon expanded into everything — electronics, groceries, streaming, and cloud computing.

twist.text: Amazon Web Services, built to run the store, became its most profitable business.

climax.text: Amazon redefined retail, logistics, and cloud computing from a single website.

punchline.text: A bookstore became the world's everything store.
